The instant Criminal Revision Application is being filed challenging the legality, propriety and correctness of the Order dated 10.06.2024 passed in connection with Complaint Case No.2003/2018 corresponding to G.R. Case No. No.2003/2018, for the offences U/S 498A, 406 of I.P.C and section 4 of D.P. Act by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class,
Jamshedpur,
whereby and whereunder the petition filed by the petitioner under section 245 of Cr.P.C. for discharge has been rejected.

The case of the prosecution in brief is that the complainant is legally married wife of the petitioner no.1, marriage was solemnized on 09.12.2016 at Telco, Jamshedpur and at the time of marriage the parents of the complainant invested approximately Rs. 28,00,000/- (rupees twenty eight lakhs).
At the time of tilak ceremony cash worth Rs.1,00,00 (rupees one lakh) was given to the Petitioner No.1 along with other ornaments.
The complainant has alleged that stridhan worth Rs.14,00,000 (rupees fourteen lakhs) was also given along with other items and the accused persons forcibly took away all her belongings.

The father of the complainant also gave Rs.8,00,000 (rupees eight lakhs) to the Abhinav Kumar Gupta vs The State Of Jharkhand on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118153472/
1 petitioner no.2.

sentences.text: Further it has been alleged that her entire belongings were taken by the accused persons and she was mentally and physically tortured by the accused persons due to non-fulfillment of their demands.

Further it has been alleged that complainant's husband was never supportive of her and used to agree with the demands made by his parents, when the maternal uncle of the complainant came to invite the accused persons for Grih Pravesh he was insulted by them.

Further she has alleged that during the festival accused persons created great disturbance in the paternal house of the complainant and tortured her by saying that they were not interested to keep the complainant at their house.
Further she alleged that the accused persons assaulted the complainant in presence of her parents, friends and relatives and tortured her due to non-fulfillment of the demands,
Hence, this case has been registered.
On 29.11.2019 the learned court below directed to issue summons to the petitioners, and thereafter after receiving the summons the petitioners appeared in complaint case no. 2003 of 2018.
Learned counsel further submits that in view of the aforesaid development following prayer for amendment is made.

"Challenging the legality, propriety and correctness of the Order dated 25.06.2024 by which the charge has been framed U/Ss 498A/406 of I.P.C and section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, by the learned Court of Judicial Magistrate, First Class,
Jamshedpur."
"15.

That it is stated during the pendency of the instant criminal revision, charge has been framed on 25.06.2024 against the petitioners U/Ss 498A/406 of I.P.C. and section & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act by the learned Court of J.M. 1 Class,
Jamshedpur.
16 . That the said charge has been framed without any application of mind and without considering the fact that there is no material against the petitioners."
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that they have attached certified copy of charge dated 25.06.2024.
It is submitted that the aforesaid prayer may be allowed and if the application is not allowed there would be miscarriage of justice.
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the opposite party no.2 has no major objection but requested for the copy of the criminal revision as well as copy of the amendment petition.
In view of the submission the prayer and amendment of the revision that are prayed for is allowed and they are made a part of the prayer in the Cr. Revision No. 731 of 2024.
Petitioner is also allowed to file the amended petition.
Counsel for the opposite party no.2 has requested for copy of the criminal revision and also the amended petition which may be filed.
